_note: PRIVATE USE ONLY: IKEA 3D models from the ikea.com/ro product pages (rotera viewer, https://web-api.ikea.com/ro/ro/rotera/static/models/<item>-mini.glb). Never publish them or commit them to a public repo. Extras = hall 11 (inside x 7.312..8.873, y 3.64..9.25; the apartment's ENTRANCE DOOR is in its east wall, y 5.096..5.940, hinged at the south end, opens inwards) + the laundry niche east of 'Oficiu' 12 (x 9.48..10.607, y 13.064..13.728; only 0.549 m wide east of x 10.116). x, y = footprint centre in plan metres (x right, y up); rot_deg = world rotation.y = plan angle CCW; the model's front (+z in the GLB) faces plan angle rot_deg - 90. dims_mm = from the product page (w x d x h). "wall": true = wall-mounted: x, y is the point on the wall face (the model's back sits on it) and "lift" = height of its lowest point above the floor. "tilt_deg" rotates the model about its own x axis first (the IKEA mirror is modelled lying flat). A piece with "parent" sits in that piece's frame: "local" = [x across, height above the parent's bottom, z towards its front] in metres, rot_deg relative. "kind" = drawn from code, no IKEA model: mirror_glass (reflective pane over the mirror's glass), stack_kit, dryer, coat.
